title: viRusneRd5/cmvresistancefinder pipeline - params.input schema (FASTA input)
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input when params.input_type is 'fasta'

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and can only contain letters, numbers, '.', '_' and '-' (no spaces, colons, slashes, etc.) - it is used directly as an output file name throughout the pipeline, and characters such as ':' can silently break some tools (e.g. samtools) even though nothing else flags them as invalid.

fasta.errorMessage: A FASTA file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fa', '.fasta' or '.fna'. One multi-record FASTA per sample, one record per resistance gene, with the gene name at the start of each header (e.g. '>UL54'). Paths may be absolute or relative to the samplesheet.
